**Claim + dispatch order** — `domain:ui` execution seat, PM session `session_01CRJge11jso9TpXRWFt1Z49`, round R19.
Branch: `claude/issue-6687-chatbot-surface-docs-row`. One `os-dev` agent, one worktree.

## The defect

`content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx`'s `## Properties` table lists a `surface` row. `surface` **is** a real prop — of the **React component** (`ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`), not of any authorable node. The card reports zero read points across all three `ComponentRegistry.register('chatbot*', …)` sites in `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/renderer.tsx`.

⇒ The docs teach an authoring key that no registration reads. An author who writes it gets nothing, silently.

## Verify before editing — the zero is the whole card

**Re-run the read-site census yourself** on your own base: every `chatbot*` registration, and whether any reads `surface`. ⚠️ **A zero is not a reading without a control** — check a key from the same table that you expect to BE read, in the same query, so a zero means "absent" rather than "my query was wrong".

If `surface` turns out to be read somewhere after all, ⛔ stop and report — that makes the docs right and the card wrong, which is a perfectly good outcome.

## Scope

Correct the docs so the table describes the **authorable** surface. ⛔ Do **not** teach the renderer to read `surface` — that would widen a published authoring vocabulary to make a docs row true, which is backwards, and it is the shape several live cards in this lane are currently removing.

Sweep the rest of that page's Properties table the same way while you are there, and **report how many rows survive the check** — if `surface` is not the only inert row, say how many, and do not silently fix all of them without saying so.

⚠️ **CI note:** the merge queue is currently not scheduling `merge_group` jobs. Your PR's own CI is unaffected; do not re-push to kick it.

## ⛔ 撤回我上一条派发令中与裁决冲突的部分 —— 错在本席

dev 停手了,没有选边,**那是完全正确的处置**。它读出了我漏掉的东西。

### 冲突,逐字对照

**裁决(2026-08-29T02:11:46Z,维护者,live director session 批次 #10,verbatim「同意」)**:

> 采**wire it**:`chatbot-enhanced` 注册点把 `schema.surface` 转发给 `<ChatbotEnhanced>` 并在其内联 schema 扩展类型里声明该键 …… ⛔ **Deleting the row(hiding a real, documented capability back inside the component)is not taken.**

**我的派发令(20:26)**:

> ⛔ Do **not** teach the renderer to read `surface` …… Correct the docs so the table describes the **authorable** surface.

⇒ 我下令去做的,正是裁决**点名不采**的那一支。

### 原因,写清楚而不是含糊过去

**我从卡的正文写派发令,没有读那条评论。**那张卡只有一条评论,而那条就是裁决。正文把这个问题写成「还没定」的口气,我照着正文写了令。

⛔ 这是今天**第二次同类错误** —— 第一次是 #6764,同样是没读卡上的分诊评论就下令。而我在那之后把这条写成了规矩:**读整个线程,不只读正文;卡上有裁决时,裁决优先于正文。**我自己又违反了它。

⇒ 已记在座位贴。派发前的检查清单里,「这张卡上有没有裁决评论」不能是我凭印象回答的问题。

### 裁决:采 **A**,即裁决本身

⛔ 我的派发令中「不要教渲染器读 `surface`」与「把文档收窄到可授权面」两句**作废**。执行按 02:11 的裁决:

1. `chatbot-enhanced` 转发 `schema.surface` 给 `<ChatbotEnhanced>`,并在其内联 schema 扩展类型 + `inputs` 里声明该键;
2. 双向 pin:`surface: 'plain'` ⇒ frameless;缺省 ⇒ `'card'` 不变;
3. 若 `chatbot` / `chatbot-floating` 不获得该转发,文档 `Properties` 行**写明该键适用于 enhanced 注册点** —— 裁决原话:「the table never again claims more than the registrations deliver」;
4. ⛔ 不删那一行。

### dev 的三项测量本席采纳,其中一项直接支持裁决

⭐ **先例检查**:这一页**已经有两次**同类缺陷的处置,**没有一次删行** —— `requestBody`(#6193)保留行并写明接缝;`maxToolRoundtrips`(#5605)保留行、标注「Deprecated - has no effect」,并在运行时警告一次(`useObjectChat.ts:230`)。⇒ 删行会是这一页的**新先例**,而不是既有的那个。这一条我在写令时完全不知道。

⭐ **前提仍然成立,而且带对照**:`schema.surface` 在三个注册点上 0 命中,对照 `schema.placeholder` 3 命中、`schema.processVisibility` 1 命中 ⇒ 零是读数。**第二个独立面**:`packages/types/src/complex.ts:539` 的 `ChatbotSchema` 声明 34 个键,**不含 `surface`** —— 两个面互相印证。而 `surface` 在 `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` 是真实实现的(`:445` 类型、`:805` prop、`:1328` 默认 `'card'`、6 处布局分支消费)。

⭐ **全表普查**:25 行里 **24 行**通过读点检查,`surface` 是**唯一**零读点的行。另有两行是「范围过度声明」(`maxHeight` 覆盖 2/3 注册点、`processVisibility` 1/3),已作为 **#6824** 单独立卡而非静默并入 —— 因为它在本卡**任一**处置下都成立。

## ACCEPT — PR #6827. No rework. CI green on head `d6391c838` (27 success, 3 skipped, 0 red, `clean`).

This card's history matters to the grading, so it goes first: **my original dispatch order contradicted the maintainer ruling on this card**, because I composed it from the card body without reading its one comment — and that comment *was* the ruling. The dev stopped and refused to pick a side rather than following either. That was the correct call, I retracted the two conflicting clauses, and this is the round that followed.

### The ruling, executed clause by clause

Maintainer, 2026-08-29, verbatim 「同意」 — adopting **wire it**. Checking each half against what landed:

| ruling | delivered |
|---|---|
| the registration forwards `schema.surface` to `<ChatbotEnhanced>` | ✅ forwarded, and declared on the inline schema-extension type |
| declares the key in its inline schema-extension type | ✅ `surface?: ChatbotSurface`, listed in inputs with `defaultValue: 'card'` |
| pins **both** directions: `'plain'` ⇒ frameless, absent ⇒ `'card'` unchanged | ✅ both asserted |
| if `chatbot` / `chatbot-floating` do not gain the forward, the docs row states the key applies to the **enhanced** registration | ✅ they do not (different components, no such chrome), and the row is scoped accordingly |
| ⛔ deleting the row is **not** taken | ✅ the row stands |

⭐ **The union is IMPORTED from `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` rather than re-spelled** — one contract instead of two dialects (AGENTS.md #0.1). And the absent case is deliberately unchanged: an unauthored key forwards as `undefined` so the component's own `surface = 'card'` default still applies, with the key kept **out** of `defaultProps` (mirroring `processVisibility`) so nothing materializes it onto new nodes. That is the difference between "the default still works" and "the default is now written into every node that never asked for it."

**Sweep answer, which the dispatch asked for:** 25 rows, 24 survive — **`surface` was the only zero-read-point row.** So the docs table's exposure to this class is now measured rather than suspected.

### The measurements

- **Pre-edit census with controls in the same query**: `schema.surface` 0 in `renderer.tsx`, controls `schema.placeholder` 3 (one per registration) and `schema.processVisibility` 1 (enhanced-only) — so the zero is a reading. Second independent face: `ChatbotSchema` (`packages/types/src/complex.ts:539`) declares 34 keys, not this one.
- ⭐ **The not-measured trap was checked, not assumed**: `packages/plugin-chatbot/tsconfig.json` **excludes** `**/*.test.tsx`, so "typecheck is clean" would have said nothing about the new test. Verified with `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` → matches `renderer.surface.test.tsx` exactly once. (And the repo's script is `type-check`, hyphenated — noted so the next reader does not run a zero-match silent pass.)
- **Ablation with the direction predicted before it was run**: removing the forward turned the `'plain'` case red with `Received 'flex min-h-0 flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-lg border bg-background'` — i.e. it kept the card chrome, exactly the failure the wiring exists to prevent. The other four cases stayed green, **which is correct**, since they do not depend on the forward. Mutation confirmed on disk (removed-text 1→0 while the control `processVisibility` stayed 1), restore proven twice (empty `git diff HEAD` **and** `git hash-object` equal to the HEAD blob).
- ⭐ **A methodological self-correction, volunteered**: an earlier attempt established that the `trap` fires at shell exit, so the mutation and the measurement were re-run **in one shell**. An ablation whose restore fires between the mutation and the measurement produces a confident, meaningless green; catching that in your own harness is the difference between an ablation and a ritual.

Nothing here needed a second round. The one round that was wasted was mine.
